correctness.rationale: For a star whose m ordinary arms have length one and exceptional arm length t, write zero-sum leaf coefficients as equal-arm fluctuations, common sum s and exceptional coefficient b, with hub coefficient −s−b. The p-distance quadratic form has m−1 transverse eigenvalues −2^p and a 2×2 Schur-complement block. Its negativity is equivalent to H_p(t)^2≤2[2−(m−1)2^p/m] for H_p=((1+t)^p−t^p−1)/t^{p/2}. H_p is monotone in p in the required interval and bounded by 2^p−2, yielding a unique threshold p∈(1,p₀), p₀=log₂[2m/(m−1)], and a one-dimensional null direction at equality. The exact invariance H_p(t)=H_p(1/t) proves t↔1/t reciprocity. The balanced minimum at t=1 is log₂[2(m+1)/m]; expansion near t↓0 yields p₀−p∼p₀² t^{2−p₀}/(4 ln 2) when m≥3 and the Lambert-W logarithmic critical law for m=2. Independent high-precision roots and full zero-sum negative-type matrices were checked on both sides of threshold. Infinite monotonicity, global inequality and asymptotics follow the analytic arguments, not these tests.
